title: States for a machine body
statement: Given two types of states, the body-state type has distinguished states for copying, rewriting the tape, handling the input tape at its initial position, rewriting the input tape, anchoring, and starting the second machine. It also has states for calling the first machine, each carrying one of its states, and for calling the second machine, each carrying one of its states.
hypotheses_covered: Two types of states, one for each machine
